description: DRAFT candidate from experiments/covid-rsv-search-20261124 (not installed, for the user to decide). Equal mixture of three recipes: T (GRU encoder, direct quantiles, US-only summary, network on artificially preliminary histories plus final-value labels of the last 4 weeks, correction trees learned from real archived report pairs; the 20 Nov T.pN_gru.real), N.multiscale (submitted member: network on finalized histories, multiscale features, quantiles) and S (sampled GRU, US-only summary, network on tree-corrected histories, real-pair trees; the 20 Nov S.Ah.gru_national.real). Each refit on all of 2022-23 through 2025-26, labels the finalized future COVID admissions and ED shares as of 12 Nov 2026, artificial reporting errors drawn from 2025-26, 80 seeds (42-121) per recipe, on panel-coverage.npz. Held-out seasons (48 seeds): -2.0% log-admission WIS against the submitted covid-gru-four mixture refit the same way, both seasons lower, -6% in peak weeks; 2023-24 guard +0.7% (inside the 1% margin), guard ED share -5%. Checkpoints in the Longleaf campaign folder nowcast-20261113.
